sloka: एषाम् कोटि सहस्राणि नव पन्च च सप्त च ।तथा शन्ख सहस्राणि तथा वृन्द शतानि च ॥६-२८-४॥।।
transliteration: eṣām koṭi sahasrāṇi nava panca ca sapta ca ।tathā śankha sahasrāṇi tathā vṛnda śatāni ca ॥6-28-4॥।।

translations.english: "These Vanaras are nine, five and seven thousand crores in number. They are in many thousands of Sankhas and Vrindas."
